summary: Bundle Builder feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend endpoints (config/preset/preview) return correct data with accurate tiered discount math (0/8/12/15%). Frontend /bundle page renders 5 slot cards, tier chips light up as items are added, preset auto-fills 3 slots with a 12% discount totalling 96.54 EUR (<100 EUR), variant picker dialog works, remove/change controls update the tier, 'Aggiungi tutto al carrello' pushes bundle-tagged items into the cart with the 'Nuovo PC' badge and crossed-out list prices, then routes to /checkout. Home CTA, nav link and IT->EN language switch (incl. tier labels '8% off/12% off/15% off') all functional.

cases: GET /api/bundle/config -> slots (os,office,security required; creative,utility optional) + tiers 8/12/15%
GET /api/bundle/preset/nuovo-pc -> 3 selections referencing windows-11-pro/w11p-1pc, office-2021-professional-plus/o21pp-1pc, kaspersky-standard/ks-1d1y
POST /api/bundle/preview with invalid slug/variant -> silently dropped, no 500

verified: /bundle loads with data-testid=bundle-page and title 'Componi il tuo Nuovo PC.'
Tier chips 2+/3+/4+ visible; 2+ and 3+ chips highlight (!bg-white !text-black) at 3 items
bundle-preset-btn auto-fills 3 slots; summary shows subtotal 109,70 €, discount −13,16 € (−12%), total 96,54 €
bundle-remove-security drops to 2 items and only 2+ tier remains active with 8% discount
bundle-pick-creative opens variant picker dialog listing products; bundle-variant-* buttons select and update summary
bundle-add-all-btn adds items to cart (drawer opens showing 'Nuovo PC' badge on each row and crossed-out list price), toast confirms, then navigates to /checkout
Cart subtotal (201,34 €) reflects discounted unit prices (windows 35,11 / office 43,91 / lightroom 122,32) — matches 12% factor at time of add
home-bundle-cta present on Home; nav-link-bundle present and routes to /bundle
Language toggle IT->EN switches title to 'Build your New PC.' and tier labels to '8% off / 12% off / 15% off'

issues: Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — a11y nit, add DialogDescription.

critical_code_review_comments: BundleBuilder.jsx line 60 uses `productsByCat &&` but Object.values still runs; low risk but redundant. Fine.

cart.js addBundle stores per-item unit price computed with discount factor at add-time — if the user re-opens the builder and adds again, tier could differ; acceptable for MVP but note that removing an item from the cart drawer does NOT re-price the remaining bundle items.
Preset endpoint silently swaps to variants[0] if variant id missing — could hide catalog drift; consider logging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bundle Builder confirmed working. If cart drawer bundle re-pricing on remove is later added, retest that the discount recomputes.
